item: Row 366(c): the corpus encryption, panic wipe, free-space overwrite and uninstall results follow a language switch, and the import report says how many articles are not analysed yet (R832, R830 Q3)
summary: encryptCorpus, panicWipe, secureErase and uninstallApp wrote t() output straight into their nodes, so the words stayed in the first language after a switch. They now draw through ooLive/ooLiveHtml with every translated word computed inside the render; the wipe's result and the free-space overwrites run under it share one render, and a new wipe replaces the overwrites listed under the last one as before. The uninstall dialog's English lines are keyed (11 new keys x12); the typed words stay the ASCII WIPE and UNINSTALL. The four lines left configs/i18n_frozen_renderers.txt. The import report gains an Analysis section: N articles in the corpus not analysed yet when it was written (corpus-wide, read fresh after the swap past the 30 s cache), nothing at 0, and an unread count is said as unread, never 0. No write, no schema change, no version bump.
